_comment: Global Claude Code hooks rivendell owns. ~/.claude/settings.json is NOT in any repo, so hook SCRIPTS being committed does not mean a new machine actually runs them — this manifest is the missing half. Install/repair with `sk hooks install` (idempotent; matches on command string). Paths use the ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ deploy symlink so they survive a repo move; run `sk deploy` first.

hooks.why: Deck generation is blocked while a storyline.md exists that is not signed-off (slide-workflow Gate 0). Escape: SK_SKIP_STORYLINE_GATE=1 or .storyline-gate-off
Migration writes are blocked while the repo's qa-dataflow function map is older than 30 days. Escape: SK_SKIP_DATAFLOW_GATE=1 or .dataflow-gate-off
